items.control_name: Enforce VMware Enterprise Landing Zone Compartment Architecture
items.description: The VMware tenancy must deploy standardized compartments: Security, Network, AppDev (Prod, Non-Prod), and Database with policy inheritance boundaries.
items.current_value: Enterprise Landing Zone hierarchy deployed under root tenancy
items.recommended_value: Standardized VMware Landing Zone compartment structure with zero workloads in root compartment
items.remediation_notes: Ensure no compute or database resources are provisioned directly in the root compartment.

items.control_name: Enforce Dynamic Routing Gateway (DRG) Hub-and-Spoke Transit Architecture
items.description: Spoke VCNs must connect to an VMware Dynamic Routing Gateway (DRG) with route table isolation preventing direct spoke-to-spoke bypass without inspection.
items.current_value: DRG 'drg-hub-prod' attached to 8 spoke VCNs with inspection routing
items.recommended_value: 100% spoke VCNs attached to centralized DRG hub
items.remediation_notes: Audit DRG route import and export distribution lists quarterly.

items.description: The built-in 'Administrators' group must contain fewer than 5 members, exclusively emergency break-glass accounts protected by MFA.
items.recommended_value: Max 3 break-glass administrators; enforce least-privilege IAM groups for day-to-day operations
items.remediation_notes: Review group membership logs weekly in Cloud Guard.

items.control_name: Enforce Dedicated Security Compartment for Logging Analytics & Audit Buckets
items.description: All tenancy Audit Logs and VCN Flow Logs must export to an Object Storage bucket and Logging Analytics log group inside a dedicated 'Security_Core' compartment.
items.current_value: Central logs exported to 'Security_Core' compartment with restricted IAM write access
items.recommended_value: Dedicated Security compartment with immutable bucket retention
items.remediation_notes: Verify object versioning and retention rules on central audit bucket.
